title: Choosing stays — budget
text: For a budget trip, target simple guesthouses, hostels or well-reviewed budget hotels near a transit-friendly area. Compare total price, cancellation terms, room cooling/heating, distance from the station and recent guest feedback. Do not assume amenities from a price tier.

title: Choosing stays — balanced
text: For a balanced trip, choose a verified mid-range hotel or heritage-style stay close to the planned neighbourhood. In Jaipur, old city versus Amber has different logistics; in Udaipur, old city versus Fateh Sagar changes walking and evening access. Check current reviews and pickup logistics before booking.

title: Choosing stays — premium
text: For premium trips, compare heritage hotels, palace stays and lake/desert properties by location, transfer time, inclusions and cancellation terms—not marketing labels alone. Desert properties need special scrutiny for transport, camp standards and included activities.

title: Choosing stays for wildlife
text: For Ranthambore, select a stay only after a safari is actually booked or its reporting point is known. Confirm whether transfers are included and leave time for the safari check-in process.

title: Heritage hotels and havelis
text: Heritage properties range from restored mansions to modern hotels using heritage styling. Ask about original features, room location, accessibility, lift/stairs, noise, heating/cooling, meal inclusions and current cancellation terms; verify identity and total price directly.

title: Choosing the right neighbourhood
text: Choose a lodging area based on your daily route, station/airport access, evening plans and mobility needs. Jaipur’s old city and outskirts have different traffic patterns; Udaipur’s lakeside/old-city and outer areas differ in slopes and transfer times. Check actual pickup logistics, not just map distance.

title: Accommodation booking checklist
text: Before booking, confirm the exact address, taxes and fees, cancellation/refund policy, check-in deadline, room occupancy, bed configuration, accessibility, hot water, cooling/heating, payment method and contact number. Save the confirmation offline and reconfirm late arrivals.

title: Desert camp comfort and inclusions
text: Ask a desert camp to specify location, transfer, tent/bathroom type, heating, meals, performance, water, accessibility and cancellation terms. Night temperatures and services depend on season and property. Confirm all inclusions and responsible animal-welfare practices directly.

title: Hostels and solo stays
text: For hostels, compare room type, locker, quiet hours, mixed/dedicated dorm arrangements, bathroom access, security, guest policy and late check-in. Confirm the exact current location and transit options. A listing or name does not verify safety or availability.

title: Family accommodation needs
text: Families may want adjoining beds/rooms, lift or ground-floor access, child-suitable food, secure windows, quiet hours and reliable transport. Confirm occupancy and any child policies with the property; do not infer these from photographs.

title: Accessible accommodation checklist
text: Ask the property about step-free entrance, lift dimensions, accessible bathroom, grab bars, bed height, path surface, parking/drop-off and emergency support. Request photos or written confirmation for your specific needs; “accessible” is not a standardized guarantee.
